Principal PM — Credit Decisioning, EMEA remote.

Oakline (130 people, Series B, revenue growing 2x) builds lending infrastructure for European consumer-credit providers. We're hiring a Principal PM to set direction for our credit-decisioning product across two squads, without formal reports. Fully remote within Europe. You've shipped underwriting or credit-decision product at a fintech, can go deep with engineers on data integrations, and can run pricing and approval-rate experiments.
